app.title: BigFred — Wizard
app.subtitle: Event kiosk
app.disabledHint: Set "enabled": true in /data/etc/bigfred/wizard/bigfred-wizard.json (changes apply without restart).

login.heading: Welcome to the event
login.lead: Sign in with the organizer account to run the wizard for participants.
login.layoutHint: Choose the layout the wizard will run on.
login.layoutsError: Could not load the layout list.
login.stateMismatch: Sign-in state mismatch — please try again.

home.heading: What would you like to do?

tiles.accountHint: Login, PIN and a DCC address pool
tiles.drive: I want to drive — help me set up a handset or phone

drive.heading: Set up driving
drive.pickDeviceHint: Tap the large card that matches your device.
drive.alreadyPairedAsk: It looks like you already have a paired handset. Do you want to unpair the previous one and pair a new one?
drive.replacePairing: Yes, unpair and pair a new one
drive.waiting: Waiting for the device to pair…
drive.pairingRetryHint: If pairing did not work — no panic, try entering the code again.
drive.expired: Time ran out. Let's start pairing again.
drive.pickLoco: Which locomotive do you want to drive?
drive.pickLocoHint: The handset can control all of your locomotives. Pick the one we will show in the next steps.
drive.noLocos: This participant has no locomotives in the roster yet.
drive.howToEnterTitle: How to select locomotive “{{name}}” on the device

android.title: Android phone or tablet
android.hint: Phones with the Google Play store, e.g. LG, Motorola, Samsung, Xiaomi, Sony, Asus, Nokia, Honor, Blackberry

railbox.title: Railbox Railroad Control app
railbox.hint: Drive from a phone with Railbox

withrottle-advanced.title: Other WiThrottle app (advanced)
withrottle-advanced.hint: Pair over WiThrottle — for advanced users

program.whoDrives: Who will drive with this handset?
program.pinWifredHint: The same code you got when the account was created.
program.pinLongfredHint: The same PIN you use to sign in to BigFred.
program.enterPairingTitle: Put the handset into pairing mode

wifredEnter.1: Turn on your WiFred (flip a locomotive switch up).
wifredEnter.2: Hold the yellow Shift button for 5 seconds until the red light starts blinking.

program.pickVariantTitle: Which LongFred model do you have?

steps.1: On the powered-on handset, hold * (Menu) and the red Stop button together for 8 seconds until a light starts blinking.

program.scanEmpty: No handset found. Make sure it is on in pairing mode and try again.
program.rosterTitle: Choose the locomotives you want to drive
program.rosterHint: Pick up to {{max}} locomotives. Selection order is the order on the handset (1, 2, 3…).
program.rosterMaxReached: You can pick at most {{max}} locomotives on this handset.
program.rosterEmpty: You have no locomotives yet. Add some in the locomotive wizard first.
program.wifiMissing: Wi‑Fi is not configured in the wizard. Ask the operator to fill in the settings.

errors.busy: The handset is busy — try again in a moment.
errors.radioBlocked: The radio is blocked. Ask the operator for help.
errors.wireless_unavailable: Programming is unavailable. Ask the operator for help.
errors.forbidden: Not allowed to program the handset.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

phone.scanPlayTitle: Scan the code and install BigFred
phone.scanPlayLead: Open the camera or a QR scanner on the phone and point it at this code — it opens Google Play.
phone.scanWebTitle: Scan the code and open BigFred
phone.scanWebLead: Open the camera or a QR scanner on the phone and point it at this code — it opens BigFred in the browser.
phone.androidUrlMissing: No Android app URL in the config (androidAppUrl). Ask the operator to fill it in /data/etc/bigfred/wizard/bigfred-wizard.json.

driveSteps.1: Open the BigFred app or website on the phone.
driveSteps.2: Sign in with the participant login and PIN (the same ones from account setup).
driveSteps.3: On the home screen open the throttle / locomotives.
driveSteps.4: Pick your locomotive from the list and drive with the on-screen controls.

steps.powerOnWlanmaus: Turn on the WlanMaus with the OK (Light / OK) button.
steps.openAnyLoco: Open any locomotive (any address) with the arrow keys.
steps.openPairingLoco: On the device, open the pairing locomotive.
steps.connectBigFred: Connect to the BigFred server on the club Wi‑Fi.
steps.orPairingLoco: Or select the “Pair with BigFred” locomotive and press these keys:

wlanmaus.1: On the WlanMaus go to locomotive selection (library or address mode).
wlanmaus.3: Confirm with OK — you can drive.

railbox.1: In Railbox open the locomotive list.
railbox.2: Add or select the locomotive at address {{address}} ({{name}}).

withrottle.1: In the app open the BigFred locomotive list.

account.heading: New participant account
account.pinAdvice: A simple numeric password you will remember — e.g. your spouse’s or child’s year of birth. You will need it to program a handset or use the phone app.
account.rememberCredentials: Remember your login and PIN — you will need them to sign in on the phone app.
account.pinTooShort: The PIN must be 4 to 6 digits.
account.loginTooShort: The login needs at least 3 characters.
account.summaryLead: The account gets a pool of {{count}} DCC addresses.

pair.noUsers: No accounts yet — create a participant account first.

loco.heading: Locomotive setup
loco.noDccPool: Sorry — you have no DCC address pool. Please ask the layout administrator.
loco.pickLoco: Which locomotive are we setting up?
loco.pickLocoHint: Pick from the list, or add a new one if it is missing.
loco.addNewLoco: I did not find my locomotive on this list — I need to add it
loco.addressExplain: Everyone has a list of DCC addresses they can assign to their vehicles — here are yours. Your new vehicle will get DCC number {{address}}
loco.functionListDescribe: You can optionally copy a function list onto your vehicle from another vehicle, so the BigFred phone app or a LongFred handset shows function names and icons. This step is optional — your model may not be on the list; if so, choose “Basic”.
loco.outsidePool: The address must be inside your DCC pool.
loco.putOnTrackProgram: Put the locomotive/vehicle on the programming track and tap Program.
loco.programSuccess: Address {{address}} written to the decoder. Vehicle “{{name}}” is ready.
loco.testF2Hint: F2 runs on the powered main track (ops). Move the loco off the programming track onto powered rails, then tap the button — F2 stays on for 1 second.

errors.unauthorized: Session expired — please sign in again.
errors.dcc_bus_unavailable: No connection to the command station (dcc-bus). Open the layout in BigFred and retry.
errors.no_programming_station: No command station has a handset server enabled (Z21 / WiThrottle).
errors.programming_timeout: The command station did not answer in time.
errors.wizard_disabled: The wizard is disabled in the configuration.
errors.dcc_pool_exhausted: No free DCC addresses left in the pool.
errors.qr_url_unset: No URL configured for this QR code.
errors.busy: The handset is busy — try again in a moment.
errors.radioBlocked: The radio is blocked. Ask the operator for help.
errors.wireless_unavailable: Programming is unavailable. Ask the operator for help.
errors.wireless_timeout: Programming did not answer in time.
errors.wifi_not_configured: Wi‑Fi is not configured in the wizard. Ask the operator to fill in the settings.
errors.forbidden: Not allowed to program the handset.
